instruction: Search for and bookmark the personal websites of all equal-contribution authors (marked with asterisks), grouping them into a browser bookmarks folder named 'Equal Contributors.'

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying equal-contribution authors (marked with * in the PDF: Guanzhi Wang and Yunfan Jiang) and bookmarking their websites in a folder named 'Equal Contributors'. The evaluator uses a custom fixed version of is_expected_bookmarks that uses the configurable 'names' parameter. Verified from PDF page 1 that these two authors are marked with '*Equal contribution' notation.

URL matching logic correctly handles multiple acceptable URLs per author using product combinations (lines 42-53)
The getter (get_bookmarks) correctly extracts Chrome bookmark data from the Bookmarks JSON file
The evaluator properly verifies all instruction requirements: folder name 'Equal Contributors', contains bookmarks for both equal-contribution authors, and URLs match expected values
